title: Curriculum-Adapted Robust Reinforcement Learning for UAV Deconfliction in Adversarial Environments
abstract: arXiv:2506.21129v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) increasingly rely on reinforcement learning (RL) for navigation, yet global navigation satellite system (GNSS) spoofing attacks can induce out-of-distribution observation shifts that corrupt value estimation and degrade mission performance. Existing robust RL methods often lack generalization to unseen attacks. To address this, we propose a curriculum-guided adaptation framework that progressively exposes a robust policy to gradient-based adversarial observation perturbations of increasing intensity while aligning temporal-difference (TD) error distributions across curriculum stages. By preserving TD-error consistency rather than targeting specific attack models, the framework promotes resilience across attack conditions. We further derive a TD-space generalization certificate that bounds performance degradation when the TD-error distribution under a test-time attack remains sufficient

translated_title: 对抗环境下无人机冲突消解的课程自适应鲁棒强化学习
translated_abstract: 自主无人机日益依赖强化学习（RL）进行导航，然而全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）欺骗攻击会引发分布外观测偏移，破坏价值估计并降低任务性能。现有的鲁棒强化学习方法通常缺乏对未见攻击的泛化能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种课程引导的自适应框架，该框架逐步使鲁棒策略暴露于强度递增的基于梯度的对抗观测扰动，同时在各课程阶段之间对齐时序差分（TD）误差分布。通过保持TD误差一致性而非针对特定攻击模型，该框架提升了在各种攻击条件下的韧性。我们进一步推导了TD空间泛化证书，当测试时攻击下的TD误差分布保持充分一致时，该证书可界定性能退化的上界。
tldr: 提出一种课程引导的自适应鲁棒强化学习框架，通过逐步增加对抗扰动强度并对齐TD误差分布，使无人机在GNSS欺骗攻击下获得对未见攻击的泛化韧性，并提供界定性能退化上界的理论证书。
en_tdlr: A curriculum-guided adaptation framework progressively exposes robust RL policies to increasing adversarial observation perturbations while aligning TD-error distributions, enabling UAVs to generalize against unseen GNSS spoofing attacks with a TD-space generalization certificate bounding performance degradation.
